name: Church Disposables FOB | Alaskan Thunder Fuck
description:
Alaskan Thunder F#*! (ATF) is a legendary sativa strain that originated in the Matanuska Valley of Alaska. Initially a Northern California Sativa crossed with Russian Ruderalis, it was later enhanced with Afghani genetics in the late 70s.

Known for its relaxing yet intensely euphoric high, ATF also enhances appetite and promotes creativity and focus. The strain's flavor profile features earthy pine notes complemented by a hint of citrus and skunk.

The Church Fob features an advanced ceramic heating element and preset temperature control with 410mAh of power. It's rechargeable, requiring no additional components.
